project_name.justification: The text announces an agreement related to the New Afton Mine. Quote: '...pleased to announce that it has entered into an agreement relating to its strategic partnership with Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan (“Ontario Teachers’”) at the New Afton Mine (“New Afton”)...'

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified at the beginning of the press release. Quote: 'New Gold Inc. (“New Gold” or the “Company”) (TSX and NYSE American: NGD) is pleased to announce that it has entered into an agreement...'

ceo_buyer.justification: A quote in the article identifies the President and CEO of the acquiring company. Quote: '...stated Patrick Godin, President and CEO.'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction increases New Gold's interest to a final holding of 80.1%. Quote: 'New Gold will increase its effective free cash flow interest in New Afton to 80.1% (the “Transaction”).'

primary_commodity.justification: The project is described as a copper and gold asset. Quote: 'This is an excellent transaction where we are able to increase our free cash flow exposure in a copper and gold asset which we already own and operate.'

verified_article_link.justification: No verifiable article link was provided in the source text.

currency.justification: The document specifies the currency at the beginning. Quote: '(All dollar figures are in US dollars unless otherwise indicated)'

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is $275 million, comprising an upfront payment of $255 million and a conditional one-time payment of $20 million. Quotes: '...in exchange for an upfront cash payment of $255 million from New Gold.' and 'In addition, following a change of control within 20 months following completion of the Transaction, Ontario Teachers’ would also receive a one-time cash payment of $20 million.'

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction consideration was an upfront cash payment. The mention of shares relates to a bought deal equity financing to fund the cash payment, not a direct payment of shares to the seller.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The payment terms were explicitly defined as cash payments, so this field is not applicable per the financial data extraction hierarchy.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The 87,300,000 shares mentioned are part of a bought deal financing to raise capital for the cash payment, not a direct payment of shares to the seller. Quote: 'New Gold has entered into an agreement with a syndicate of underwriters... to purchase, on a bought deal basis, 87,300,000 Common Shares... The Company intends to use the net proceeds of the Offering to fund a portion of the cash payment to complete the Transaction.'

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any share warrant payments as part of the transaction.

option_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any option payments as part of the transaction.

issued_share_price.justification: The $1.72 price per share is for the bought deal financing to raise capital, not a price for shares issued as consideration to the seller. Quote: '...purchase, on a bought deal basis, 87,300,000 Common Shares at a price of $1.72 per Common Share...'

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text does not mention any exploration commitment in meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text does not mention any monetary exploration commitment.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction involves an amended 'free cash flow royalty agreement', which is not specified as a Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) or Gross Revenue Royalty (GRR) in the rules. Quote: 'At closing, the parties will enter into an amended free cash flow royalty agreement...'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text does not mention the coverage area of the project.
